story.fullStory:
Biz Markie's "Just A Friend" reached #9 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Just a Friend" is a song written, produced and performed by American hip hop artist Biz Markie.

It was released in September 1989 as the lead single from his album The Biz Never Sleeps.

It is Markie's most successful single, reaching number 9 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1990.

The song peaked at #9 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.

Marcel Theo Hall (April 8, 1964 – July 16, 2021), known professionally as Biz Markie, was an American rapper, singer, songwriter, DJ, and record producer who gained prominence during hip-hop's golden age.
He was known for his comedic style and often called the "Clown Prince of Hip-Hop".
